title: John Carmack Tech Talk with UMKC-SCE
channel: UMKC School of Science and Engineering
summary: John Carmack speaks at UMKC's 2017 commencement event about the difficulties of VR, especially end-to-end latency across hardware and software. He covers why latency and buffering matter and how nausea is addressed.
why: Recommended whenever latency, buffering or VR comfort comes up, as an accessible account from someone who dealt with it directly.

quote.text: a lecture where he describes the difficulties in VR in a manner that anybody with minimal programming experience can understand
